title: Morning rush in Paris: every train, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in Paris, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every train inside the city on an average October weekday.

The timetables are from October 2026. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside the Paris city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Métro, RER A, RER B, RER C, RER D and RER E, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment of the morning: 488 trains at 8:46 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable. Île-de-France Mobilités starts its October timetable on October 9, so the earlier days are left out.
